description: Asking the current value of a curated preference maps to the preferences tool's read_setting (not write_setting, and not a Settings hand-off). CI-safe: defaults read succeeds whether the key is on, off, or unset.
prompt: Is my Dock currently set to auto-hide?

description: 'Are hidden files showing in Finder?' is a read of an existing preference, so it maps to read_setting rather than write_setting. CI-safe.
prompt: Are hidden files showing in Finder right now?
